title: Diabetes, hypertension and CKD together
question: Assign the ICD-10-CM codes for the patient's diabetes, kidney disease and any related hypertension and dialysis status.
note:
Chief Complaint
Follow up for maintenance hemodialysis and T2DM.

HPI
Pt is a 76 y/o female presenting for routine follow up. Pt currently on maintenance hemodialysis for end stage renal disease. Pt reports feeling stable today. Pt manages type 2 diabetes with diet only; denies any recent episodes of severe symptoms. Pt reports compliance with dialysis schedule.

Medication List
Hemodialysis
Dietary modifications for T2DM

Exam
Gen: alert and oriented x3. 
Vitals: BP 128/78, HR 72, RR 16, Temp 98.6 F.
Ext: No new skin breakdown noted.
Lungs: CTAB.
Heart: RRR.
Labs: Recent eGFR <15 mL/min/1.73m2.

Assessment
1. ESRD on maintenance hemodialysis.
2. T2DM managed by diet.
3. CKD.

Plan
1. Continue current hemodialysis schedule.
2. Continue diet for T2DM management.
3. F/u as scheduled.

Electronically signed, 
P. O'Brien, PA-C
05/12/2026
explanations: Type 2 diabetes and CKD are linked by the 'with' convention unless the provider says otherwise: E11.22 (HCC 37).
The CKD stage is coded in addition: N18.6.

distractors.why: The 'with' convention presumes the diabetes caused the CKD.
E11.22 says to use an additional code for the CKD stage.
Dialysis status is reported with Z99.2.
